content.summary: Completed parallel exploration of direct Agents SDK integration - 4 explorers dispatched

key_findings.vercel_coupling: High coupling - streamText, wrapLanguageModel, ModelMessage, tool schemas used across session, prompt, MCP, and agent flows
key_findings.tool_issues: Provider-executed tools processed by Vercel AI SDK, fails validation and remaps to _providerExecuted losing original tool name
key_findings.session_issues: providerOptions['claude-agent-sdk'].sessionId defaults to 'default' causing session collisions, tool-bridge context fallback
key_findings.sdk_native_api: query() is primary entry point, yields messages directly, has native session management via resume parameter

options_emerging: Feature-flagged Claude direct path (4-8hrs, low risk)
Introduce internal model interface (1-2 days, medium risk)
Full replacement of streamText pipeline (3-7 days, high risk)
